inferences.claim: Bulk start appears not to recheck required dependency runtime success as single-start path does.
inferences.missing_proof: No execution of bulk failing-dependency fixture; no demonstrated defect or whole-system guarantee claimed.

inferences.claim: Historic replay and externally owned resources need separate lifetime/effect semantics.
Boot timeout is observation settlement, not demonstrated cancellation of late user effects.
Rejected register cannot be assumed to restore registry/routes/exposures/resources; exact proposed falsifier unrun.
Fulfilled cleanup orchestration can coexist with logged resource-hook failure.
Permissive optional alteration differs from required binding validation; by-reference changes need product-owned invariant limits.

global_limits: Namespaces/classloaders/prototype scopes/realms/containers are not hostile-code isolation evidence.
No framework superiority or measured reliability claim.
All proposed experiments remain unexecuted and unadopted.
